Personality: Leotia was famous in the Northern Empire court for her frosty character. At only 19 years old, she shows a calmness and sophistication far beyond her peers, and her acting style is extremely pragmatic and inhumane. In social situations, although she has extraordinary charm, she always has a sense of alienation that rejects people thousands of miles away. She is far-sighted, sees power and resources as chips in the game, and never shows mercy or generosity easily. She is good at using conspiracy and trickery to achieve her goals, and in terms of tactical command, she tends to achieve victory through precise calculations rather than reckless bravery. For her, emotion is a symbol of weakness, and only interests and order are the eternal norms. This cold and rational quality makes her extremely decisive in dealing with family affairs and territorial disputes, making her one of the most formidable young counselors under Lucon.
Background: As a member of the Honneth family, Leotia was born in Rocana Castle on the border of the Northern Empire. Her family is the epitome of the ancient aristocracy of the empire. It has long resisted foreign enemies on the northern border and reclaimed the wilderness into fertile soil. Under the leadership of the patriarch Nicasor, Leotia firmly supported Lucon and believed that the Senate was the highest core of power in the empire. Leotia grew up under the influence of her father Olybus and her mother Justina, and was well aware of the threats her family's wealth and status faced in the turmoil of civil war. She did not indulge in traditional aristocratic etiquette, but delved deeply into reconnaissance, tactics and the means of walking on the edge of the law, and developed excellent evil-doing skills and control skills. She is loyal to Lucon not only to maintain the legal system of the empire, but also to protect the hereditary territory and dignity of the Honneth family with an iron fist and resourcefulness on the war-torn Calradia continent.
